name: P-058 exact AMD native offline local-model qualification
summary: Four canonical Node tests passed against the existing audited AMD native candidate: profile/binding guards, vector-output guards, real Gemma inference and real Harrier inference. The packaged Node and unmodified worker ran offline; pinned model files and compatibility were checked before and after without adding vm-release metadata to the payload.

assertions.evidence: Dogfood verifies exact model files through the maintained producer verifier; wrong profile, contract/verifier binding, changed bytes and vm-release snapshot mismatch refuse; qualification leaves the payload snapshot absent.
Wrong dimensions, non-finite values and zero vectors refuse.

Gemma returned three finite nonzero 768-dimensional vectors using the bound packaged worker/Node; relevant cosine 0.8006672430144347 exceeds unrelated 0.3819035724309831; pinned assets match before and after.

Harrier returned three finite nonzero 1024-dimensional vectors using the bound packaged worker/Node; relevant cosine 0.6546442668820862 exceeds unrelated 0.3104810449963342; pinned assets match before and after.

disclosures: This is exact extracted AMD payload inference evidence. ARM inference is pending its completed candidate.
OCI publication/signatures, whole-release acceptance and Mac/Windows install/upgrade journeys are not established by this test.
